# Integrate local payment gateway (Stripe or Mercado Pago)

Description

Add integration for a local payment gateway (evaluate Stripe vs Mercado Pago) and implement checkout wiring for production payments.

Acceptance criteria

- Payment provider selected and integration adapter implemented.
- Checkout completes payment and records payment status.
- Tests for payment success/failure flows and reconciliation.
